item.title: SF Microclimates
item.description:

Every SF neighborhood mapped with hundreds of sensors:.

item.title: Show HN: A desktop app that blocks work when you bite your nails
item.description:
📝 TrackHands TrackHands is a cross-platform desktop app that detects when your fingers are near your mouth and reminds you to stop. mov Installation From Release Download the latest release for your platform from the Releases page. Features Real-time hand and face detection using MediaPipe Unobtrusive system tray app Warning overlay when hands are detected near mouth Camera preview with detection visualization Adjustable detection frequency Configurable camera resolution Screenshot capture of detected incidents Privacy-focused — all processing done locally Requirements macOS 11+, Windows 10+, or Linux Built-in camera or compatible webcam Camera permissions enabled Development Requirements Node.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/cacoos/trackhands

item.title: Show HN: NukeCast – If it happened today, where would the fallout go
item.description:
📝 This is what a potential nuclear strike impacting the U. NukeCast uses current weather forecasts to simulate where radioactive fallout may travel, how it disperses through the atmosphere, and where it could settle—so you can quickly identify likely downwind areas and make more informed preparedness decisions. If you find this useful, consider upgrading to Premium—Amazon compute time ain’t cheap.
🔗 Read more: https://nukecast.com/
